greedy_unchanged_explanation: Early free first-report probabilities are bit-identical because the R66 intervention froze the shared trunk and early_head. The R71 critic calibration moved only the two value heads, so it can only reach the actor through the late_head gradient; the late head did move on 294/294 visited late free states, but the smallest |p-0.5| margin was 0.0401 (R71) and the largest single-decision shift reached at most 0.4865 of the way to the boundary, so no greedy decision crossed p=0.5. Hence greedy first-report actions, task sets and metered cost are identical to R68 on all 192 cells.

advantage_contract.gae: per-decision-next-value; A_t = r_t + gamma*bootstrap - V + gamma*gae_lambda*next_A; returns = A + V
advantage_contract.critic_targets: two heads regress the GAE returns return_task / return_cost (gamma=1 undiscounted future sum) with a value baseline; NOT a raw TD residual
advantage_contract.advantage_normalization: none (per-episode std division forbidden); task/cost not separately normalized
advantage_contract.dual_update: lambda_next = max(0, lambda + eta*g_hat); g_hat = E[Y_ref]-E[Y_policy]-delta in on-time-tasks-per-episode units
advantage_contract.cost_baseline_counterexample: A_cost = return_cost - V_cost with V_cost ~ E[cost]; the baseline containing expected cost does NOT cancel the cost policy gradient (E[-A_cost*dlogpi/dz] = -c*p*(1-p), = -0.2436c at p=0.58). No narrative may claim the cost baseline neutralises cost pressure without an independent wiring counterexample.
advantage_contract.quantification_limit: only persisted late_actor_grad_l1 / critic_grad_l1 quantify actor contributions; RMSE~1.01 is a value fit, not a gradient noise std; no new autograd opened

effective_logit_evidence.recorded_probability: send_probabilities = softmax over the 2 one-shot actions of the routed-head logits from controller.forward
effective_logit_evidence.routing: ready_step = round(f[18]*1000) - round(f[0]); early_head if <=147 else late_head; uses only the legal 19-D input
effective_logit_evidence.mask: real sequential budget mask applied in the collector before the choice; a non-affordable candidate is forced HOLD (not a free choice, no RNG spent)
effective_logit_evidence.prior_scope: beta=1.00 gate prior is a TRAINING auxiliary loss on early first-emission free rows only; it is NOT an eval-time additive logit term, so eval probabilities are pure routed-head softmax
effective_logit_evidence.head_scale_caveat: late_init_alpha=0.10 only scales the late head initial network term; it does not prove the margin cannot cross zero later, and the unscaled prior cannot be assumed to preserve margin sign
effective_logit_evidence.no_greedy_flip_framing: 0/1098 argmax flips is reported for this actual fixed scheme; it is NOT claimed to be structurally locked
effective_logit_evidence.coverage: recorded pre-action 19-D features, effective SEND probability, action and candidate_audit charge are persisted per free decision in the tapes
effective_logit_evidence.missing: no separate raw pre-softmax logit panel beyond the recorded effective probability; probability shift, training difference and sampled-eval RNG are reported as separate channels
